name: Jack Lee
profile: Computer Science & Information Technology student and Software Engineering Intern on a CI/CD platform team at Ericsson. Contributes to Jenkins/Groovy and Spinnaker workflows for cloud-native services, with hands-on experience in Python tooling, Kubernetes and Docker infrastructure, client web development, and automation-focused personal projects.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Contribute to CI/CD delivery for cloud-native services, building and maintaining Jenkins/Groovy and Spinnaker workflows while supporting Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm/Helmfile infrastructure.
Proposed and implemented a 14-file refactor of a 2,000+ line Python CI module, separating shared and executor-specific decorators and using parameterisation to standardise definitions.
Improved release safety by adding packaging verification and Artifactory/Nexus checks to identify undeclared binary content before release, with automated test coverage.
Investigate CI/CD and cloud-native infrastructure issues across Kubernetes, Docker, Helm/Helmfile, and pipeline integrations; document findings and coordinate fixes with other teams.

experience.title: Web Development Intern
bullets: Collaborated on full-stack website projects through implementation, QA, and release, communicating progress and incorporating feedback to help ensure changes were ready for client use.
Turned client and team feedback into practical page improvements, refining layouts and responsive behaviour while maintaining visual consistency across desktop and mobile.
Diagnosed and resolved frontend issues across existing sites, checking responsive behaviour and improving usability without disrupting established pages.
Delivered responsive, accessible PHP and SCSS updates for Kerry International Film Festival, MCL Electrical, Anushka Power Therapy, Daily Irish Produce, and Capital Homes.

experience.title: Cashier & Customer Service Representative
bullets: Provided clear, helpful service while handling transactions and resolving customer queries in a high-volume retail setting.
Coordinated with a small team to prioritise tasks, communicate changes, and keep checkout operations running smoothly during busy periods.

experience.title: Fast Food Crew Member (Cashier & Kitchen Team Member)
bullets: Coordinated cashier and kitchen duties with teammates, using clear handovers to keep customer orders accurate during high-volume shifts.
Responded constructively to changing customer needs and priorities, helping the team maintain efficient service under pressure.

projects.title: Deal Ledger
projects.technologies: Hugo, Python, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Workers, DNS
bullets: Build and maintain a multilingual affiliate deal-discovery site with localised interfaces and market-specific routing across English, German, Dutch, and French.
Automated Amazon deal-candidate review, listing and price validation, builds, SEO checks, alert emails, domain and DNS configuration, and Cloudflare routing with Python and GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Multi-Broker Paper Trading Platform
bullets: Built a modular Python platform for researching and operating rules-based paper-trading strategies across FX, CFDs, and US equities, separating strategy, execution, risk, market data, journaling, and dashboards.
Integrated IG, Capital.com, and Alpaca paper/demo workflows with SQLite journaling, risk controls, broker smoke checks, and automated tests.

projects.title: Unity Racing Game
projects.technologies: Unity, C#, NavMesh AI, JSON and CSV persistence
bullets: Developed race and hot-lap modes with configurable lap counts, checkpoint validation, timing, reset handling, and a CSV-backed top-10 leaderboard.
Implemented three NavMesh-controlled competitors following a 200+ node JSON race path, including corner-speed adjustments and respawn behaviour.
